title: 第891章 做梦认识的第890章 堂姐坠入爱河
slug: 算命太准外国客户都哭着喊大佬
content_zh:
第891章做梦认识的
于是他们便继续追问，想看看堂姐和对方进行到哪一步了，或者需要他们帮忙支个招也行。
结果堂姐却告诉他们，她其实还没有和男生真正见过面。
所以，难不成堂姐和对方是在网恋？
汤元他们当时都是这么认为的。
毕竟堂姐已经明确地说她陷入爱河了，那总不可能是单方面的陷入爱河吧，就算和男生没有真正见上面，肯定也有其他接触方式。
网恋就是他们能想到的最普遍，也是最正常的接触方式了。
而且现在这个社会，因为生活节奏太快，大部分年轻人都特别忙，大家都更专注于自己的生活，很少有时间坐下来和一个陌生人面对面交流。
因此网恋其实也成了一种常见的沟通交友的方式之一。
没想到汤元他们竟然还是猜错了。
堂姐和那个男生并不是网恋认识的。
而是做梦认识的。
做梦认识的？
啥意思，堂姐是在开玩笑吗？
当时汤元他们全都傻眼了，忍不住开始怀疑，这件事情是不是从头到尾都是堂姐开的玩笑。
如果她就是这样说出来逗他们玩的话，虽然有点无语，但情况还算合理。
如果堂姐真是在梦里遇见了一个男人，然后还爱上了对方，那才是真的可怕，好吗！
汤元几人被这个消息给震撼到了之后，便只能继续追问堂姐真实情况。
结果事实证明，堂姐竟然不是在开玩笑，她是真的在梦里认识了一个男人，并且爱上了对方。
并且据她所说，虽然这个男人只在她梦里出现过，但她非常确定，对方绝对存在于这个世界上的某个角落。

虽然汤元他们并不知道她是如何得出的这个结论，但依旧被堂姐的这番发言给惊得目瞪口呆。
因为他们很清楚地意识到，他们所认识的堂姐，绝对不会是一个在梦里梦到一个什么男人，就会死心塌地地爱上对方的人。
她以前还曾经多次劝过一个年纪比较小的追星的堂妹，在得知那个堂妹将明星幻想成自己的爱人时，堂姐不但不理解，还严肃地教育对方要认清现实，不要沉溺在虚无的幻想中。
所以堂姐在他们眼中一直是以清醒冷静著称的。
没想到她竟然会因为梦，爱上一个从来没有在现实当中见过面的男人。
content_en:
Chapter 891: We met in a dream
So they continued to ask, wanting to see where their cousin and the other party were at, or if they needed help with a move.
As a result, the cousin told them that she had never actually met the boy.
So, is it possible that the cousin and the other party are dating online?
Tang Yuan and the others thought so at the time.
After all, my cousin has clearly said that she is in love, so it cannot be a one-sided fall in love. Even if she does not actually meet the boy, there must be other ways of contacting him.
Online dating is the most common and normal way of contact they can think of.
And in today's society, because the pace of life is too fast, most young people are very busy. Everyone is more focused on their own lives and rarely have time to sit down and communicate face-to-face with a stranger.
Therefore, online dating has actually become one of the common ways of communicating and making friends.
Unexpectedly, Tang Yuan and the others guessed wrong.
My cousin and that boy didn’t meet through online dating.
But I met him in a dream.
Did you know him in a dream?
What do you mean, is my cousin kidding?
Tang Yuan and the others were all dumbfounded at that time, and couldn't help but begin to wonder if this matter was all a joke made by their cousin from beginning to end.
If she just said it like this to tease them, although she was a little speechless, the situation was still reasonable.
If my cousin really met a man in a dream and fell in love with him, that would be really scary, okay?
After Tang Yuan and others were shocked by the news, they could only continue to ask their cousin about the real situation.
It turned out that the cousin was not joking. She really met a man in her dream and fell in love with him.
And according to her, although this man only appeared in her dreams, she was very sure that he definitely existed somewhere in the world.
Although Tang Yuan and the others didn't know how she came to this conclusion, they were still stunned by her cousin's speech.
Because they clearly realized that the cousin they knew would never be someone who would fall in love with him wholeheartedly just after dreaming about any man in his dream.
She had previously advised a younger cousin who was chasing stars many times. When she learned that the cousin fantasized about celebrities as her lover, the cousin not only did not understand, but also seriously taught her to recognize the reality and not to indulge in nihilistic fantasies.
Therefore, my cousin has always been known as sober and calm in their eyes.
Unexpectedly, she would fall in love with a man she had never met in reality because of a dream.
